review_items.decision: Accept mapping ID issue2:kv-recovery-v1alpha1, the final mapping SHA-256, every bound dependency SHA, the authenticated issue-2 input snapshot, and the stated authority boundary.
Freeze only this specialty mapping and keep it non-activatable until a separately content-addressed P0-owner base-mode overlay is approved.

Accept the closed asymmetric base roster: h2d_restore emits exactly one span and three edges; d2h_preserve and transfer_wait emit zero base spans and zero base edges; issue2:kv-recovery-v1alpha1:h2d_restore is the only active P0 evidence code in this mapping.

Accept the H2D request, lifecycle, epoch, transfer, block-set, rank-0 process and clock identities; bound profile/mapping metadata; strict positive duration and bytes; e-to-e+1 relation; exact three edges; the transfer_id pending context with max_pending_h2d_contexts_per_process=4096 that alone justifies the internal instrumented-execution-context edge; deterministic attempted-record record_seq consumption plus serialization_failure loss and no base pair/edge when that table is full; fail-open serving; and the first admission_started after successful scheduler wakeup as the return target.
Accept D2H as exact profile submit/done evidence only, with no inferred request return edge, and fail closed on failure, orphan, duplicate, retry, nonpositive duration or bytes, or identity drift.

Accept transfer_wait as one run/process-scoped point and exact member relation: capture the wait-entry timestamp, enqueue contiguous chunks only after normal return, derive wait_call_observation_id from the first chunk record ID, forbid request fan-out, and do not fabricate a wait duration.

Accept the SHA-bound Draft v4.3 device semantics used here, including per-device completeness, unassigned-stream behavior, legal point-only zero-duration records, productive zero-duration rejection, canonicalization, clock calibration, four evidence layers, and the matched-runtime-A/B claim boundary; this does not approve global M0.

Accept content-addressed immutability and gate boundaries: any byte or dependency change requires a new digest; a D2H base span or paired wait interval requires a new version; this approval cannot activate the P0 overlay or authorize G1, NPU, service launch, an experiment, a performance claim, or M0.

minimum_overlay_scope: one exact connector-capable kv_cache_mode value and validation grammar
binding to the base contract, recovery profile, issue2 mapping, and resolved configuration digests
explicit acceptance that only h2d_restore is in the base paired-operation roster while d2h_preserve and transfer_wait remain profile-only zero mappings
explicit acceptance of the preempted-to-communication-to-next-admission recovery bridge as the specialty child-edge interpretation
